name: Kearsney Abbey Play Area
description: A new inclusive play area opened in July 2026, with a large multi-play unit with slides, tunnels and climbing, a wheelchair-accessible roundabout and trampoline, a basket swing, a multi-user seesaw, sensory play and supported swing seats, for children up to 14.
